items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT for Sunday vs NE due to foot injury.
items.why: Foot injury; practice LP-DNP-DNP pattern led to downgrade.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; PIT WR depth tested.
items.opportunity: Potential bump for DK Metcalf and other PIT receivers.

items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT (hamstring) on ETR Sunday fantasy injuries report after missing practices; Texans WR room thins significantly.
items.why: Hamstring injury suffered in Wednesday practice; DNPs Thursday/Friday; official OUT designation.
items.implication: Remove from all lineups; redistribute HOU targets to secondary WRs and TE.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining HOU pass-catchers including Dalton Schultz.

items.text: Zay Flowers (and Ja'Kobi Lane) OUT OR DOUBTFUL on ETR list; hamstring issue after limited/no practice early week.
items.why: Hamstring; missed practices then limited Friday but doubtful designation.
items.implication: Plan as OUT; BAL WR hierarchy collapses to Bateman et al.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/targets for remaining BAL WRs and Mark Andrews.

items.text: Brock Bowers OUT OR DOUBTFUL (knee) per ETR Sunday report; limited practice but unlikely.
items.why: Knee (post-meniscus); returned limited Friday but doubtful; team to test pregame.
items.implication: Do not start; pivot to healthy TE early window.
items.opportunity: Potential volume to other LV pass-catchers if inactive.

items.text: Ladd McConkey QUESTIONABLE (ribs); limited Friday after DNPs.
items.why: Ribs from Week 1; DNP Wed/Thu, limited Fri; game-time feel for late window.
items.implication: GTD; affects Herbert and LAC passing game projections heavily.
items.opportunity: If OUT, boost to Quentin Johnston and other LAC targets.

items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay: Puka Nacua will not practice Saturday due to hip injury and listed questionable for MNF vs Giants.
items.why: Hip/groin injury; second straight DNP; different from camp psoas.
items.implication: Monitor closely for MNF; have pivot ready; backup Whittington also doubtful.
items.opportunity: If OUT, heavier TE usage (Ferguson/Parkinson) and bump to other LAR WRs like Konata Mumpfield or Malachi Fields.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate; affects so many other projections including Justin Herbert. Game at 4pm ET.
items.why: Ribs impact routes/contested catches; cascading projection effects on LAC offense.
items.implication: Major slate disruptor; update all related rankings/projections immediately on news.
items.opportunity: Monitor for volume shifts if limited or out.

items.text: Patriots desperately need playmakers with AJ Brown on IR; do they give TreVeyon Henderson 10+ touches in his 2026 debut? Returning at right time with nice upcoming matchups.
items.why: NE lacking explosives; AJ Brown IR; strong schedule stretch (PIT/JAX/etc) before bye.
items.implication: Watch for meaningful role vs Stevenson; flex upside in debut.
items.opportunity: Carries/routes potential expansion in pass/run game for playmaking.
items.conflict: Unclear exact share vs Rhamondre Stevenson workhorse Week 1.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson listed IN on ETR Sunday injuries; set for 2026 debut.
items.why: Ankle cleared; full practice and 'ready to go' comments.
items.implication: Debut opportunity vs PIT; monitor touch share vs Stevenson.
items.opportunity: Potential 10+ touches in explosive role for desperate NE offense.

items.text: Joe Burrow QUESTIONABLE but said he's playing; expected active vs HOU.
items.why: Back issue; practiced and coach/player comments indicate good to go.
items.implication: Start with confidence; CIN offense intact vs Texans.

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN; returns to NO backfield.
items.why: Cleared for return; expected to play.
items.implication: Squeezes Etienne/Miller committee further; Kamara likely third-down/pass role.
items.opportunity: Reclaim receiving work; monitor early-down split.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 24%+ target share (tied team lead), 74% snaps/21-of-24 RB touches through 3Q Week 1; Indy just gave up big to Henry.
items.why: Elite Week 1 utilization (target % on routes, snaps); soft run matchup.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; massive season upside if healthy.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/carry share continuing; receiving upside.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score Week 1 (2nd only to Bijan); 19% target share recent; 25+ touches often.
items.why: Near-max utilization under Kubiak; passing-game involvement; favorable road spot.
items.implication: RB1/high-end RB2 start; overreaction to prior injury scare.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: 26% target share, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell Week 1; good matchup.
items.why: Career-high target share + exclusive RZ; CLE allowed solid YPC/rush yards.
